authorized_scope: Implement additive documentary fields and minimums from proposal route B
verified_cases: Six complete documentary types can process under general minimums
Missing or illegible essential data requires human review
Every laboratory result needs its own exam and literal value
Issuer is not inferred from requester
Diagnosis does not replace image findings or conclusion
Performed study does not replace requested procedure
Unknown type and placeholder values cannot pass on high classification alone
Urgency, low confidence and prior review are preserved
POST through real local pipeline persists new fields in memory and GET recovers them
Legacy JSON remains readable without rewriting storage
Web and Flutter retain additive fields in raw JSON without application logic changes
limitations: Structural documentary completeness does not certify clinical accuracy or signature authenticity
New values are exposed in API and original JSON; existing summary views are not extended
Real provider and deployment acceptance remains for the other computer
Restart backend after applying the coordinated model, prompt and profile changes
